orchestrator.description: Project manager for task state machine, moves Backlog -> Todo -> In Progress

planner.description: Lead architect for grill-me review, validates spec.md/plan.md against line-spec constraints

executor.description: Senior engineer implementing code in feature branches following plan.md

deploy.description: Deploy GAS script changes locally and to GitHub
deploy.template: python3 app_scripts.py && git add long-shot-bot.js docs/plan.md && git commit -m "${1:-deploy}" && git push origin main

status.description: Check task state and remaining work from plan.md
status.template: echo 'Task status:' && cat docs/plan.md | grep -A2 '### Task' && echo '\nGit status:' && git log --oneline -3
